question: Can ontology-derived hierarchical information improve ranking within the already-corrected SHIFT-MAP Top-100 candidate set, particularly for structurally ambiguous mappings, without relying on mapping-label leakage or changing retrieval membership?
population: Frozen corrected SHIFT-MAP Top-100 candidates for Track A ICD-9-CM to ICD-10-CM
intervention: Ontology-only structural features with a small source-balanced hierarchy-aware reranker
comparator: B0 frozen SHIFT-MAP ordering; B1 frozen Step 8 MedCPT seed-17 ordering
test_policy: No Step 9 TEST scoring before a future configuration freeze and Step 9 TEST lock
prior_test_exposure: Aggregate corrected SHIFT-MAP and MedCPT Step 8 TEST results predate this design; no individual TEST failures were inspected for feature invention.
